textPrompt: Create a professional, investor-ready 10-slide PowerPoint pitch deck for a fictional Nigerian agritech startup called FarmBridge AI. The startup helps smallholder farmers improve crop yields through AI-powered crop disease detection, weather insights, and market-price recommendations. Structure the slides as follows: 1. Title and compelling tagline, 2. Agricultural challenges, 3. Our AI-powered solution, 4. How the platform works, 5. Target customers and market opportunity, 6. Business model and revenue streams, 7. Competitive advantages, 8. Go-to-market strategy, 9. Illustrative financial projections, and 10. Investment opportunity and conclusion. Use unique, concise slide titles and substantive business content. Include a relevant agricultural photograph on the title slide, a process diagram explaining how the platform works, a comparison table for competitive advantages, and a clearly labeled chart showing hypothetical three-year revenue projections. All financial figures must be explicitly identified as illustrative assumptions, not real company performance. Use a modern green, cream, and dark charcoal design theme with strong contrast, professional typography, appropriate icons, and varied slide layouts. Avoid duplicate slides, repetitive layouts, empty sections, raw image descriptions, unreadable text, and unsupported factual claims. Generate exactly 10 slides.
